body:
The Joe Jonas summer is one of my favorite chapters to explain to new fans 🤍 It's 2008, Taylor's 18 and deep in the making of Fearless, and for about three months she and Joe are one of the most talked-about young couples going.

Then it ends — famously, in a phone call clocked at 27 seconds. But she doesn't bury it: 'Forever & Always' lands on Fearless as the song everyone reads as her reply, and the heartbreak becomes part of the record instead of a secret.

That's exactly what Blank Spaces is for — not gossip, but a confirmed, sourced map of who she actually wrote about and when. This is the chapter right after her early solo years: the first famous name on the timeline.

Photo: Taylor on the Fearless set of the Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023 — Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons.
